description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 fuzzpro: every window of a protein sequence that matches a PROSITE-like pattern: amino-acid letters (case-insensitive; B = D or N, Z = E or Q, J = I or L; x = any residue), classes [ILV], exclusions {P} (plain letters only: B, Z, J, X inside [] or {} are rejected as in the binary), repeats x(3), length ranges x(2,4) (every matching window length is reported; (0,n) makes the element optional), '-' separators, the anchors '<' (N terminus) and '>' (C terminus), a terminating '.'; e.g. [DE](2)HS{P}x(2)Px(2,4)C. The search is exact unless mismatch > 0 (fuzzpro -pmismatch; verified on 750 random patterns with 1 - 3 mismatches). A start-anchored pattern with a range reports only its longest match (the binary's regular-expression search class); a single trailing stop '*' is not part of the sequence. Positions are 0-based; hits are ordered by position, then length (with mismatch > 0 and a range: the program's order, a window listed once per matching unrolling). Verified against fuzzpro 6.6.0 on 900 random patterns (letters, classes, exclusions, repeats, ranges, anchors; sequences with X, B, Z, U, J, O, * and lower case). For nucleotide patterns see find_pattern_hits (fuzznuc), for a translated search fuzztran. Input sequences are read as EMBOSS reads them (A4-3, one shared reader): only letters and '*' are kept; gap characters (- . ~ ?), '#', '+', '_', digits, blanks and every other character are dropped first, and positions, lengths and scores count the cleaned sequence (e.g. needle of AC-GTTAGC.TT* and ACGTTAGCTT: score 58, length 11, as the program).

sequence.description: Protein sequence (letters; a trailing * is dropped).

sequenceQualifiers.description: EMBOSS sequence-input qualifiers as on the command line: -sbegin 3 -send -2 -sreverse -slower -supper -scircular -snucleotide -sprotein (begin / end 1-based, negative = from the end; -sreverse reverse-complements a nucleotide sequence, the range then refers to the original). Measured on EMBOSS 6.6.0 per program: fuzzpro searches the range and counts positions from the start of the original sequence; a protein is never reversed. The text is resolved exactly as the EMBOSS program resolves it on its command line after the sequence arguments (ACD, 6.6.0): -sbegin1 3, -sbegin1=3, -nosreverse1, -sreverse1 N, any case, -/--/ prefix, and every UNIQUE abbreviation (-sbeg1, -sre2; uniqueness is decided among all qualifiers of the program, an ambiguous or unknown one is refused). The number is the sequence (1, and 2 for the second sequence of a two-sequence program; 1 for a program with one sequence). An unnumbered qualifier belongs to the LAST sequence given (-sbegin 3 is -sbegin2 3 in a two-sequence program) until a qualifier of another sequence ends that tie; after that it applies to all sequences. -sformat selects the file format of the text; -ufo -fformat -fopenfile name the feature file of a program that takes the features of its sequences (diffseq: the files are given by the tool); -sask -squick -sdbname -sid -iquery are accepted without effect (residue strings have no file); any other qualifier or a stray word is refused.

reportFormat.description: EMBOSS report format (-rformat): any of simple embl genbank gff gff3 pir swiss dasgff debug listfile dbmotif draw restrict excel feattable motif nametable regions seqtable srs summary table tagseq (diffseq needs 7 report tags: refused as the program does; embl / genbank are nucleotide only, pir / swiss protein only), or the report qualifiers as typed after the files, e.g. '-rformat table -raccshow -rdesshow -rscoreshow -rstrandshow -rusashow -rmaxall 5 -rmaxseq 2'. The report FILE of the program (header with the command line, one block per sequence, footer; #Rundate / #!Date is now; sequence name from sequenceName) is returned in the result field report. Omit for no report text.

sequenceName.description: Sequence name printed in the report (default sequence).

mismatch.description: Maximum substituted residues per hit (fuzzpro -pmismatch, default 0 = exact; must be less than the real pattern length for a pattern with a class or an exclusion and no range: the program stops otherwise). Embpat's search engines: Baeza-Yates-Perleberg, Tarhio-Ukkonen-Bleasby (its skip table knows the letters A-Z only) or the recursive brute force, which with a range lets a mismatch fall only on the mandatory part and lists a window once per matching unrolling; each hit then carries its mismatches (the report: Score = length - mismatches and a *mismatch note).
